C1.worst_defect: The hero puts three calls to action side by side: two buttons ("Live demo", "Quick start") and an underlined text link "For cashiers: At the till". A note under them then links "quick start" again, so the eye has four targets before it reaches the screenshot. On phone the text link drops onto its own line below the buttons.

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table says the demo sends "anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com". That is a different brand's domain, and the table doesn't explain the wcpos connection, so a careful reader stops to wonder who is collecting the data.
C2.where: home.desktop.02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row

C3.worst_defect: The sign-in step is text only. Quick start step 8 and Connect a till 'Open your till' / 'Enter your store details' describe the "Sign in to Vendure" screen (Email and password or Device key, store URL, channel token, Barcode field) without a screenshot. The first screen a developer meets on their own store is the only one the docs don't show. The payment, cashier-sheet and closure screens each have a screenshot.

C4.worst_defect: The Quick start TOC is out of order. 'Optional: a device key for each till' comes after '9. Troubleshoot', but step 4 links down to it, so the reader jumps past the troubleshooting section into an appendix and back. Step 2's heading also embeds a code chip (`TallyPosPlugin`), which makes the heading and TOC line height jump.

C5.worst_defect: The screenshots don't follow one figure style. On At the till, the cashier-sheet screenshot is a narrow (~380 px) centred card with a large empty band above it and a caption hanging from its left edge, while the payment screenshot two sections up spans the full 836 px column. The home page centres its caption and the docs left-align theirs. The home comparison table splits into equal thirds, so the 'Refund a sale at the till' cell wraps to four lines in the third column while the middle column says only "Yes".
C5.where: at-the-till.desktop.03 vs at-the-till.desktop.02; home.desktop.01 caption; home.desktop.02 table

C6.worst_defect: On phone, the cashier-sheet screenshot has a grey vertical strip along its left edge, a crop artefact from the sheet or overlay. Inside the image, "Sync now" floats indented under "Last synced 10:07 PM", so it reads as a broken render, not a clean figure. Separately, the sticky TOC bar at the top of every docs page shows the first section's name ("1. Install the plugin", "How a sale reaches Vendure") while the reader is still on the page title.

C7.worst_defect: llms.txt lists the docs alphabetically (At the till, Changelog, Connect a till … Quick start ninth), not in reading order, so an agent reading it top-down meets the cashier guide before the setup steps. The share card's subtitle also leaves "a normal order." alone on its second line.

overall_worst.defect: The At the till cashier-sheet screenshot is the one screenshot that looks unfinished. On desktop it sits as a small centred card with a large gap above it and a left-hung caption, unlike the full-width payment screenshot on the same page. On phone it carries a grey strip down its left edge and a misaligned "Sync now". That makes the docs' screenshots look inconsistent and the till look half-rendered.
overall_worst.fix: Re-capture the cashier sheet cropped tight to the sheet's own border, with no overlay edge. Render it with the same figure component, width and caption alignment as the payment screen, and make all captions on the site use one alignment.
